language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi! My name is Mateo. My family and I are taking a trip to a part of Mexico that is next to the Pacific Ocean.
I am excited because this is a new environment for me.
Do you know what an environment is?
An environment is the area where something lives.
Many things live in an environment - not only people, but animals and plants too.
We need to take good care of our environment so that everything living in it will be healthy.
Let's find out what makes a good environment and what are ways to care for the environment!
Hello, I am Tim.
Hi! My name is Mateo. My family and I are taking a trip to a part of Mexico that is next to the Pacific Ocean.
I am excited because this is a new environment for me.
Do you know what an environment is?
An environment is the area where something lives.
Many things live in an environment - not only people, but animals and plants too.
We need to take good care of our environment so that everything living in it will be healthy.
Let's find out what makes a good environment and what are ways to care for the environment!

This beach and the nearby town are nice. Everybody is able to drink clean water, breathe fresh air and eat healthy food. The town is safe and the streets have many plants and trees. This is a good and healthy environment.
But not all environments are healthy. Some are polluted and unsafe. Can you help me identify the healthy traits?

Unfortunately, there are many things like this that people do which harm the environment. Let's look at the actions that either harm or help the environment. Which are good, and which are bad for the environment?
